categories.main_business_segments: Daito Pharmaceutical operates a single business segment focused on pharmaceuticals, encompassing the manufacturing and sales of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical formulations (both prescription and over-the-counter), contract manufacturing, and health-related products. The group includes operations in Japan, the US, and China, with consolidated subsidiaries and equity-method affiliates supporting these activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated manufacturing capabilities from APIs to finished formulations, supported by advanced chemical synthesis, formulation design, and quality control systems compliant with GMP, FDA, and EMA standards. Its R&D structure is divided into specialized units for development planning, API research, formulation research, and analytical science, enabling efficient development and technology transfer. The company emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective production, including large-scale and multi-product manufacturing lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Daito primarily serves domestic and international pharmaceutical manufacturers, especially generic drug companies, by supplying APIs and contract manufacturing services. Its end markets include hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and wholesalers, with a strong focus on the Japanese generic drug market and growing engagement in the Chinese pharmaceutical sector. Major customers include large Japanese pharma companies and generic drug makers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in Japan (headquartered in Toyama), with significant manufacturing and R&D facilities. It has subsidiaries in the United States (Illinois) for market research and export support, and in China (Anhui) for manufacturing and sales. The majority of sales are domestic, but the company is expanding its presence in China and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daito operates both upstream (API manufacturing) and midstream (formulation and contract manufacturing) in the pharmaceutical supply chain. It provides integrated solutions from raw materials to finished products, supplying other pharmaceutical companies and supporting their manufacturing needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include improving operational efficiency, strengthening the China business, entering new business areas (such as orphan drugs and medical devices), optimizing capital allocation, and investing in human capital. R&D focuses on high-quality, affordable generics, new formulation technologies, and expanding contract development for orphan drugs, leveraging regulatory expertise for global markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of APIs and pharmaceutical formulations, contract manufacturing services, and, to a lesser extent, health-related products. The company also earns income from joint development projects and contract research, with a stable base in product sales to pharmaceutical manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major Japanese and international API and generic drug manufacturers, such as Sawai, Towa, and global API suppliers. Daito differentiates itself through its integrated manufacturing from API to formulation, high quality control standards, and strong supply reliability, positioning itself as a trusted partner for both generics and contract manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending May 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥50.6 billion, with operating profit of ¥2.6 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥1.9 billion. The company employs over 1,000 people and maintains a strong equity ratio (66.7%). While sales have grown steadily (8% YoY), profitability has declined due to increased depreciation, product mix changes, and inventory write-downs. The company forecasts moderate sales and profit growth for the next fiscal year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daito emphasizes its ability to provide high-quality, reliably supplied pharmaceuticals through integrated manufacturing from API to finished product, supported by robust quality management systems meeting global regulatory standards. Its unique strengths include dual manufacturing bases in Japan and China, flexible production capacity for both large and small lots, and a proven track record in regulatory compliance and stable supply, making it a preferred partner for pharmaceutical companies seeking quality and reliability.
